2025.text: As of 31 December 2023: 5,377 hospitals; 13,895 dispensaries; 504 care homes for people with leprosy; 15,566 homes for the elderly, chronically ill and disabled; 8,593 orphanages; 10,858 creches; 10,827 marriage counselling centres; 3,147 social rehabilitation centres; 35,184 other institutions. Education: 74,550 kindergartens (7,639,051 pupils); 102,455 primary schools (36,199,844 pupils); 52,085 secondary schools (20,724,361 pupils).
2025.notes: Agenzia Fides, Catholic Church Statistics 2025, Holy See Press Office, 17 Oct 2025; from the Statistical Yearbook of the Church. Two fetches agreed. Ch. 8 note 2 (entry 80). The next edition is expected around October 2026.
